name: Config Track
description: Logs changes to config entities and simple configuration into revisions.
project_description: Config Track (info.yml label "Config Revision") logs every configuration change on a Drupal 10.3+/11.1+ site into a revision history. It listens to config CRUD events for simple configuration and to entity presave/predelete hooks for config entities, preserving the exact order in which changes occurred across all config collections (including per-language overrides). A UI under /config-revisions lists recent changes with the acting user, and each entry links to a diff against the previous revision of the same config object. The module has no settings; the report is gated by the core 'administer site configuration' permission.
